readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine (at dinner)
At the moment the temple bell struck nine: Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
A thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier
Uncle's repeater sounded ten slow deep notes, after the thump
Someone came quickly down the stairs
Bastien Girard came into the library without knocking
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Girard were still sitting together in the library

durations: Félix's watch was twenty minutes slow compared with the temple bell at nine o'clock (8:40 against 9:00)
Six minutes from someone going up the stairs (10:15) to someone coming down (10:21), by Félix's watch
Three minutes from the thump (10:18) to someone coming down (10:21), by Félix's watch
About twenty-eight minutes from Girard's arrival (10:32, Félix's watch) to the temple striking eleven (11:00, temple bell); the two readings come from different timepieces
Félix and Girard sat together in the library from Girard's arrival until the temple struck eleven
whereabouts: At dinner were Félix, his uncle, Aunt Odile, Dr Vauthier, and Bastien Girard (Girard laughed into his glass and had quarrelled with Félix about the price at dinner)
After dinner Félix went up to the library and stayed there alone
Félix drank several glasses of brandy in the library
Félix did not want to sit in the salon after dinner
An unidentified person went quickly up the stairs past the library door at 10:15; Félix did not see who
An unidentified person came quickly down the stairs at 10:21; Félix did not see who
The thump at 10:18 was on the floor right above Félix, in the atelier
Félix thought the thump was his uncle dropping a tool
Félix says he was downstairs (below the atelier, in the library) at the time of the thump and the repeater
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 without knocking and sat down
Girard stayed in the library with Félix until the temple struck eleven
